curated.category: 风湿免疫与系统性血管炎
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 针对细胞核与双链DNA的大量自身抗体形成免疫复合物沉积全身微血管引发多系统破坏。虽多数呈慢性复发缓解，但突发狼疮危象如弥漫性肺泡出血（DAH）、重症狼疮性脑病、血栓性微血管病（TMA）及急进性狼疮肾炎，可在数小时至数日内因窒息、急性肾衰或机会性感染致命；长期糖皮质激素与免疫抑制亦显著推高感染及心血管死亡风险。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 以羟氯喹为基础，联合小剂量激素及双靶点生物制剂（贝利尤单抗、泰它西普），当代我国SLE患者5年生存率已从上世纪不足50%跃升至90%以上、10年生存率超80%；近年来CD19 CAR-T细胞疗法更在重症难治性狼疮患者中实现了震撼性的深度免疫重置与“无药缓解”。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO/GBD将SLE归入“其他肌肉骨骼疾病”合计数（未单独拆列全球死亡数）；多项跨国队列显示SLE标化死亡率仍为同龄普通人群的2-3倍以上，高发死因前三位为严重感染、活跃期重要脏器受累（肾/脑/肺）及早发心血管病

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国无单独SLE全国年度死亡总数；北京协和医院CSTAR多中心登记队列证实中国SLE患者5年生存率已达90%以上、10年生存率>80%，感染（约占死因半数附近）和狼疮性肾炎尿毒症/肺泡出血为主要致命诱因

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球SLE总体患病率约20-70/10万人，其中约90%为育龄期女性，黑人、亚裔及拉丁裔患病率显著高于白种人且肾脏受累比例更高。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国SLE患病率约30-70/10万人（估算全国总患病人数约100万例，居全球各国之首）；CSTAR数据展示男女比约1:10至1:12，平均发病年龄约30.7岁，儿童狼疮肾炎比例高达60%-70%。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 重症狼疮危象（弥漫性肺泡出血、狼疮神经精神危象、急进性新月体性狼疮肾炎、重症血小板减少/TMA）抢救：1) 立即静脉大剂量甲泼尼龙冲击治疗（500-1000 mg/日×3天）；2) 联合静脉环磷酰胺（CTX）脉冲或大剂量吗替麦考酚酯，合并B细胞亢进或危象难控联用利妥昔单抗；3) 弥漫性肺泡出血、抗磷脂危象（CAPS）或TMA即刻加用血浆置换（PE）及静脉免疫球蛋白（IVIG）；4) 严格排查合并机会性真菌/细菌感染避免冲击致死。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 免疫细胞治愈性里程碑：以德国团队（NEJM 2024）及中国多中心临床（CAR-T/通用型CAR-T）为代表的CD19靶向CAR-T细胞与CD19/BCMA双靶CAR-T，在重度难治性SLE患者中实现深度组织B细胞清空与免疫系统重构，多数患者随访1-2年+维持无需任何激素及免疫抑制剂的“完全无药缓解”；2) 抗I型干扰素受体单抗阿尼鲁单抗（Anifrolumab）及新型伏环孢素/奥妥珠单抗（Obinutuzumab）改善重度肾炎与皮肤受累。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 患者群体以育龄女性为主，长期大剂量激素所致的股骨头坏死、肥胖、感染及早发心血管病仍是巨大痛点；2) 中国尚有高比例重度增殖型狼疮性肾炎在10年内仍进展为尿毒症；3) CAR-T个体化自体制备成本天价及通用型细胞疗法尚处于1/2期探索。

master.definition_en: A rare, genetic, hemoglobinopathy characterized by generally mild clinical phenotype, high fetal hemoglobin levels and mild microcytosis and hypochromia. The genotype is characterized by the combination of an HbS and HbF allele; symptoms depend on the degree of HbF:HbS expressivity with patients with more than 35% pancellular HbF expression being asymptomatic. Symptomatic patients have heterocellular expression of HbF.

master.definition_en: Demodicidosis is a rare parasitic cutaneous disease due to Demodex mite infestation characterized by variable degrees of spinulosis, erythema, papules, and pustules, usually accompanied by a burning or pruritic sensation. Face (incl. eyelids) is most frequently affected, but ear canal, scalp, neck, back, chest, nipples, buttocks, penis, and extremity (legs and arms) involvement have also been observed. Dermoscopic examination reveals Demodex tails and follicular openings.

master.definition_en: A rare congenital tricuspid malformation characterized by narrowing of the tricuspid valve orifice due to congenital valve anomalies, such as incompletely developed leaflets, shortened and malformed chordae tendineae, small annulus, and/or abnormal number and size of papillary muscles, resulting in right ventricular inflow obstruction. Clinical presentation depends on the degree of stenosis, as well as the presence or absence of additional cardiac anomalies, and includes easy fatigability, swelling of the lower limbs, and hepatomegaly, among others.

master.definition_en: Lichen planus (LP) is a common inflammatory dermatosis characterized by the development of pruritic violaceous papules or plaques on mucocutaneous surfaces. Eruptions can involve the face, neck, limbs, back, genitalia, tongue, buccal mucosa, nails, and scalp. LP comprises rare variants affecting the skin and the mucosa. Rare cutaneous LP includes linear LP (referring to blaschkoid and zosteriform distributions of lichenoid lesions), actinic LP, annular LP, atrophic LP, annular atrophic LP, lichen planopilaris (comprising Graham Little-Piccardi-Lassueur syndrome and frontal fibrosing alopecia), lichen planus pigmentosus, and lichen planus pemphigoides. Rare mucosal LP includes vulvovaginal gingival syndrome and LP sialadenitis.
